posts.zh:
dsh-exa-mcp 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f75f767ca465bb76d03e.html
posts.en:
dsh-exa-mcp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f75f767ca465bb76d03e.html
